errors.evidence: The y-axis values are absolute numbers (e.g., 500 000, 1 000 000), not measured in thousands.

errors.text_span: Всяка стълба представлява броя на продадените електрически автомобили за конкретен година.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart is a grouped bar chart with two bars for each year: a blue one for the absolute number of cars and an orange one for the percentage. The description completely misses this fundamental structure.
The value for the year 2022 is 1,126,682, not 1,226,682. The digits are transposed.

errors.text_span: Стълбата за 2023 е оцветена в оранжев цвят и показва 3 193 455 продадени електрически автомобила.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The bar representing 3,193,455 cars sold in 2023 is blue. The orange bar for 2023 represents the percentage (22.3).

errors.text_span: Над стълбите са посочени процентите на електрическите автомобили от общия брой продадени автомобили за всяка година
errors.evidence: The percentage values are shown inside the orange bars, not above the bars in general. The absolute numbers are shown above the blue bars.
The percentage for 2023 is 22.3%. The value 21.6% corresponds to the year 2022.

The description fails to explain the grouped nature of the bars and omits any mention of the second data series (orange bars representing percentages) and its corresponding legend entry ("% от общия брой").
